source_study: User provided Vietnamese filmmaking/VFX encyclopedia labeled October 2025; 18 sections including section 18 absent from its table of contents
note: Includes one already-in-base Houdini review entry and some version-specific siblings; NOT count of new installed tools and NOT a verified exhaustive 2026 technology crawl.

items.name: Prism Pipeline 2
items.caveat: Free LGPL core and selected plugins; USD/Unreal/Resolve integrations require paid tiers.

items.name: OpenTimelineIO
items.caveat: Timeline metadata only, not the media files. Adapter tests required.

items.name: OpenColorIO
items.role: Consistent color transforms Blender to edit
items.caveat: Choose pinned config; ACES display/output review needed.

items.name: ACES 2
items.caveat: Color standard/config selection, not a renderer or optional automatic quality boost.

items.name: Open RV
items.caveat: Building on Windows has substantial dependencies; benchmark first.

items.name: Meta Segment Anything 2
items.caveat: Real video and model checkpoints required; output corrections/QC.

items.name: Depth Anything V2 Small
items.caveat: Official repo states SMALL weights Apache-2.0; check dependencies and model artifacts.

items.name: Depth Anything V2 Base/Large
items.caveat: Official repo states Base/Large/Giant weights CC-BY-NC-4.0, not for commercial use without separate rights.

items.name: MaterialX
items.caveat: Interoperability and shader equivalence require per-renderer tests.

items.name: CGWire Kitsu
items.caveat: Evaluate server hosting overhead before adoption; do not duplicate company control plane.

items.name: AYON
items.caveat: Modular studio platform; evaluate scope, server overhead, addon and licensing before install.

items.name: OpenCue
items.caveat: Premature for one RTX 3060 workstation unless new render farm needs justify operational cost.

items.name: Gaffer
items.role: Open-source node-based lighting, lookdev and automation
items.caveat: Requires DCC/renderer integration pilot; not essential for present Minecraft voxel look.

items.name: Epic RealityScan desktop
items.caveat: Former RealityCapture; 2026 legacy licensing shutdown; only adopt after output/license QA.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Capture
items.caveat: Formerly Moxion/PIX; paid managed service and no clear ROI for a single automated workstation.

items.name: Houdini Indie commercial evaluation
items.caveat: Houdini already in 96 inventory. Evaluate Indie revenue/funding eligibility and annual license first.

items.name: ComfyUI ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessors
items.caveat: Source mentioned by 2025 study; independent 2026 status/version/license/runtime recheck needed.

items.name: ComfyUI Impact Pack
items.role: Detailer and quality repair workflow nodes
items.caveat: Custom nodes are executable code; security, license and dependency audit before install.
